errors.evidence: The list of methods on the x-axis omits "Inter-ECNC", which is present in the figure between "Inter-EC" and "MAM-SD".
The description lists the method as "ECPE-CNN+CRF", but the label in the chart is "IE-CNN+CRF".

errors.text_span: 最短的柱状图大约为 0.55，对应的类别为“MAM-SD”的 R 值
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the shortest bar. The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to the R value for "Indep", which is approximately 0.51. The R value for "MAM-SD" is visibly higher, at around 0.58.
The description states that the value of the longest bar is approximately 0.73, but the P value bar for "ECPE-KT" clearly reaches the 0.75 mark on the y-axis.
There is a typo in the category name. The chart shows "2阶段笛卡尔积", but the description writes "2阶段笛卡尔尔".
The term "排序" (sorted) is imprecise. The methods are "grouped" or "categorized" rather than sorted by a specific criterion.
